biotools.summary: TCCIA is a cloud-based platform that combines circRNA profiles, immunotherapy response data, and clinical outcomes across multiple cancer types. It enables interactive exploration of circRNA data in the context of immune checkpoint blockade and provides tools for biomarker discovery and treatment response evaluation.
